briefs.explicit:
MISSION BRIEF M-018
Units: metres, seconds, kilograms. Time starts at t = 0 when every robot leaves its start location.

Locations (x, y, zone):
- base: (0, 0), outdoor
- solar canopy: (-118, 57), roof
- office roof: (-121, 101), roof
- pump house: (-57, -40), indoor
- storage hall: (74, -58), indoor
- transformer pad: (111, 2), outdoor
- site B: (56, -107), outdoor
- fuel depot: (76, 143), outdoor

Robots:
- D1 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 6 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg), thermal camera. Endurance: 1020 s, including the return to its start.
- M1 (mobile_manipulator): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 6 kg), robotic arm, camera. Endurance: 2640 s, including the return to its start.
- G1 (rover): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 2.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 24 kg), camera. Endurance: 4440 s, including the return to its start.
- M2 (mobile_manipulator): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 7 kg), robotic arm, camera. Endurance: 3300 s, including the return to its start.
- G2 (rover): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 2.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 21 kg), camera. Endurance: 5280 s, including the return to its start.

Tasks:
- T1: Replace the filter cartridge at storage hall. Location: storage hall. Duration: 300 s. Needs: robotic arm.
- T2: Photograph fuel depot for the condition report. Location: fuel depot. Duration: 90 s. Needs: camera. Deadline: finished by t = 360 s.
- T3: Replace the filter cartridge at pump house. Location: pump house. Duration: 210 s. Needs: robotic arm.
- T4: Photograph pump house for the condition report. Location: pump house. Duration: 60 s. Needs: camera.
- T5: Tighten the valve at transformer pad. Location: transformer pad. Duration: 150 s. Needs: robotic arm.
- T6: Run a thermal scan of office roof. Location: office roof. Duration: 180 s. Needs: thermal camera.
- T7: Tighten the valve at fuel depot. Location: fuel depot. Duration: 300 s. Needs: robotic arm. Deadline: finished by t = 1320 s.
- T8: Replace the filter cartridge at pump house. Location: pump house. Duration: 300 s. Needs: robotic arm.
- T9: Tighten the valve at pump house. Location: pump house. Duration: 150 s. Needs: robotic arm.
- T10: Tighten the valve at fuel depot. Location: fuel depot. Duration: 300 s. Needs: robotic arm.

Rules:
1. Every task is done by exactly one robot. A robot does its tasks one at a time, in the order you list them, travelling between task locations.
2. A robot can only do a task if it has the needed equipment, enough payload capacity, and can reach the task location.
3. A task that must start after another task waits until that task is finished, even if a different robot does it.
4. Each robot must be back at its start location before its endurance runs out.
5. Every task must be finished by t = 1800 s.

Objective: minimise the finish time of the last task (the makespan).
briefs.informal:
Morning! Plan for today's site work:

Positions are in metres from the base at (0, 0). Drones fly straight and can't go indoors; ground robots follow the road grid (so they travel |dx| + |dy|) and can't get onto roofs. Everyone leaves their start spot at time zero.

Places: solar canopy (-118, 57, a rooftop); office roof (-121, 101, a rooftop); pump house (-57, -40, indoors); storage hall (74, -58, indoors); transformer pad (111, 2, outside); site B (56, -107, outside); fuel depot (76, 143, outside).

The fleet: D1 is a quadcopter at base with a camera and a thermal camera; it flies at 6 m/s, can lift 2 kg, and its battery lasts 17 minutes including the flight home. M1 is our mobile manipulator at base: gripper arm, camera, room for 6 kg, moves at 1 m/s and lasts 44 minutes including getting back. G1 is a rover parked at base that hauls up to 24 kg at 2.5 m/s and runs for 74 minutes including the drive back. It has a camera. M2 is our mobile manipulator at base: gripper arm, camera, room for 7 kg, moves at 1.5 m/s and lasts 55 minutes including getting back. G2 is a rover parked at base that hauls up to 21 kg at 2.5 m/s and runs for 88 minutes including the drive back. It has a camera.

Jobs:
(T1) Swap the filter cartridge at storage hall - that takes 5 minutes on site.
(T2) Document fuel depot with pictures - that takes 1.5 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 6 minutes.
(T3) Change the filter at pump house - that takes 3.5 minutes on site.
(T4) Grab photos of pump house for the condition report - that takes 1 minute on site.
(T5) Someone has to tighten the valve at transformer pad - that takes 2.5 minutes on site.
(T6) Look for overheating equipment around office roof - that takes 3 minutes on site.
(T7) Someone has to tighten the valve at fuel depot - that takes 5 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 22 minutes.
(T8) Swap the filter cartridge at pump house - that takes 5 minutes on site.
(T9) The valve at pump house needs tightening - that takes 2.5 minutes on site.
(T10) Someone has to tighten the valve at fuel depot - that takes 5 minutes on site.

Everything has to be wrapped up within 30 minutes of the start, and the sooner the last job finishes, the better. Every robot has to make it back to where it started before its battery runs out.
